doubts.claim_under_doubt: the change is correct as reviewed by stages 1 and 2
doubts.disproof_attempt: D1 (high) DISPROVED: the append_only guard protected the case that cannot occur and ate the one it was written for - a concurrent APPEND leaves the snapshot as a prefix, so the guard passed and the append was overwritten. Zero tests touched append_only, and the one nearby test wrote its line BEFORE converge so it passed against the pre-fix code too. FIXED: an append-only log that changed at all is left alone (never destroy an appended line); the fixpoint survives because grade_snapshot is filtered out of every derived document and the triage appends are dedupKey-idempotent. converge.left_alone now surfaces what was skipped. Two new tests, one of which fails against the previous fix.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the change is correct as reviewed by stages 1 and 2
doubts.disproof_attempt: D2 (high) DISPROVED: `git commit -- <pathspec>` records the WORKTREE, not the index - so every check in this change (and every test) read something the release commit does not. Any writer between Step 5.5 and Step 6 substitutes unstamped bytes silently. That is HIGH-1 one step downstream. FIXED: a --verify-commit mode that reads `git show <sha>:<rel>`, wired into Step 6 before the tag is pushed, plus two tests.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the change is correct as reviewed by stages 1 and 2
doubts.disproof_attempt: D3 (high) DISPROVED: restore_to_head read EVERY non-zero `git checkout` as 'unknown to HEAD' and then deleted the file and reported it as restored, exit 0. On Windows a file held open by an editor or an index.lock race is ordinary, so this deleted a COMMITTED evidence document. FIXED: `git cat-file -e HEAD:<rel>` asks the question instead of inferring it; a held path is `unresolved`, never deleted.

doubts.disproof_attempt: D4 (medium) DISPROVED: Step 2b regenerates the documents and Step 2c then refuses on a dirty tree - so --refresh-pr was unreachable in exactly the case that triggers the offer (documents behind => 2b moves them). FIXED: Step 2c runs --restore first.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the change is correct as reviewed by stages 1 and 2
doubts.disproof_attempt: D5 (medium) DISPROVED: the crash handler calls restore_to_head (HEAD-resetting) while produce argues never to reset to HEAD. ANSWERED rather than changed: a refusal holds produce's found-state snapshot and rewinds precisely; a crash has that frame gone and an unknown partial tree, where 'leave nothing untrusted staged' is the only guarantee left. The cost - an operator edit does not survive a crash - is now stated in the code.
